name: Takanashi Ruui
source:
Known as a “beautiful girl hunter,” she hates men.

She is a beautiful girl prodigy who is looking for her ideal lady. She looks up to Yuu, whom she met by chance, as the older sister of her dreams.

In fact, she is a member of a dollhouse family and one of the prospective brides.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou2/index.html]official site[/url]]
